tasks.label: Stop ResourceBridge local servers
tasks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$ports = 3000,4000; $pids = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $ports -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($pids) { $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force } }"
